title: Does a Governed Confidence Score Know When a Text-to-SQL Answer Is Right? An Exploratory Study on BIRD and a Pre-registered Confirmation on Spider
abstract: arXiv:2610.17256v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conversational analytics lets people ask questions of records spread across many systems and get answers in plain language; it is useful only if each answer can be trusted and explained. A production system of this kind attaches a confidence score to every answer it writes over a database and uses it to show the answer, show it with a warning, or withhold it. The score's weights, caps and thresholds were set by design. This paper audits that design. On the 1,534 questions of BIRD dev, answered by GPT-5.1 with a benchmark-adapted production prompt and five samples per question, the designed score separates right from wrong answers weakly (AUROC 0.624, 95% CI 0.595-0.652) and withholds 35.7% of correct answers. Nearly all of its ranking signal comes from agreement among the samples, and most of it is lost where agreement is combined by a minimum with a checklist that drops to zero on any unsupported claim, including claims in commentary. translated_title: 受治理的置信度分数能否知道 Text-to-SQL 答案何时正确？基于 BIRD 的探索性研究与基于 Spider 的预注册验证
translated_abstract: 对话式分析让人们能够用自然语言向分散在多个系统中的记录提问并获得答案；只有当每个答案都可信且可解释时，它才有用。此类生产系统为其写入数据库的每个答案附加一个置信度分数，并据此决定是直接展示答案、带警告展示还是拒绝展示。该分数的权重、上限和阈值均由设计预先设定，本文对这一设计进行了审计。在 BIRD 开发集的 1,534 个问题上，由 GPT-5.1 使用适配基准的生产提示词、每个问题采样五次进行回答，结果显示该设计分数区分正确与错误答案的能力较弱（AUROC 0.624，95% 置信区间 0.595-0.652），并且会扣留 35.7% 的正确答案。其排序信号几乎全部来自样本之间的一致性，而当这种一致性通过与一个检查清单取最小值来结合时，大部分信号都会丢失——因为该检查清单在任何缺乏支持的断言（包括注释中的断言）上都会降为零。
tldr: 本文审计了一个生产级 Text-to-SQL 系统中由规则设计的置信度分数，发现其区分对错答案的能力较弱（AUROC 仅 0.624）、会错误扣留 35.7% 的正确答案，且其排序信号几乎全部来源于样本间一致性而非检查清单机制。
en_tdlr: This paper audits a governed confidence score design in a production Text-to-SQL system, finding that it only weakly discriminates correct from wrong answers (AUROC 0.624), withholds 35.7% of correct answers, and derives nearly all of its ranking signal from agreement among sampled answers rather than the checklist component.
